# Vendored W3C RDF Test Suites

Source: https://github.com/w3c/rdf-tests —
`rdf/rdf11/{rdf-turtle,rdf-n-triples,rdf-n-quads,rdf-trig,rdf-xml}`
(RDF 1.1 test suites, vendored 2026-10-20 from the codeload `main` tarball;
trig + rdf-xml added by gap-closure lane H08, same fetch).

License: dual-licensed under the W3C Test Suite License and the W3C 3-clause
BSD License (see `rdf-turtle/LICENSE` and each `manifest.ttl` header;
https://www.w3.org/Consortium/Legal/2008/04-testsuite-copyright.html).

Consumed by `tests/w3c_conformance.rs`. The (file, positive|negative)
inventory is generated by `scripts/gen_w3c_manifest.sh` into
`tests/w3c_manifest.rs`. Only `*PositiveSyntax` / `*NegativeSyntax` tests are
consumed — except RDF/XML, whose suite has no `TestXMLPositiveSyntax` class:
its `TestXMLEval` positives are admitted as parse-acceptance-only positives.
Eval tests elsewhere (which assert graph isomorphism against a result file)
are vendored but out of scope for this court. The RDF/XML suite retains its
nested per-test subdirectories; `TESTS.tar.gz`/`TESTS.zip` were excluded from
the vendor (duplicate copies of the same corpus).
